name: Delayed Potion (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
You’ve trained your body to hold offsome magical effects until needed.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Knowledge (arcana) 3 ranks.

Benefit: You can drink a potion and delay its effects for a number of hours equal to your Constitution modifier. At any point during this duration, you can activate the potion’s effect as a swift action. If the duration expires before you activate the potion, it dissipates harmlessly inside you. You can delay only a single potion at a time.

You must activate a delayed potion before you can choose to delay another one.

Breath of Life: The Spelljack, © 2022, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Authors: Connor Bates and Norman Mitchell Jr.
